question: Since healing magic isn't widespread in Vollachia, are there areas where its medical technology has surpassed that of other countries? Also, does the Emperor have a personal physician? I wonder if he listens to the doctor obediently, and whether he's ever been sick.
answer:
Well... I haven't gone deeply into this aspect yet.

But if we were to explore it, I imagine Vollachia would have developed non-magical medical technology to some extent, since otherwise a lot of things wouldn't make sense.

However, I don't think they've made much progress when it comes to major surgery or curing diseases.

It's a pretty outrageous place where sayings like, “There's no value in weaklings living,” and, “If you get sick, it's your own fault,” are common.

So I don't think medicine or pharmaceuticals have advanced very far.

There may be some knowledge of herbal remedies passed down through families or tribes, but probably not much beyond that.

On Ginunhive, Old Man Nuru was practicing a kind of folk medicine without any proper training, I think.

As for Abel, I imagine Chisha would have acted as his physician.

I don't think Abel would show his body to anyone other than Chisha, so she would have studied and practiced at least some rudimentary medicine.
